from django.db import models


class Task(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=300)
    project = models.ForeignKey("Project", on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    position = models.DecimalField(max_digits=24, decimal_places=12)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, default="todo")
    deleted_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    objects = TenantManager()
    all_objects = models.Manager()


def reorder(task, before_id=None):
    """Place task between its new neighbours using a midpoint position."""
    prev, nxt = neighbours(task.project_id, before_id)
    task.position = (prev + nxt) / 2
    task.save(update_fields=["position"])


def rebalance_column(project_id, status):
    rows = Task.objects.filter(project_id=project_id, status=status).order_by("position")
    for i, row in enumerate(rows.select_for_update(), start=1):
        row.position = i * 1024
        row.save(update_fields=["position"])


def soft_delete(task):
    task.deleted_at = now()
    task.save(update_fields=["deleted_at"])

import redis

from app.settings import base as settings

QUEUES = ("default", "webhooks", "exports", "search")
conn = redis.Redis.from_url(settings.QUEUE_REDIS_URL)


def enqueue(queue, func, *args, delay=0, max_retries=3):
    assert queue in QUEUES
    job = {"func": func.__name__, "args": args, "retries_left": max_retries}
    conn.zadd(f"q:{queue}", {dump(job): now() + delay})
